objection.quote: Attempted to compute X's optimal response to L's marks via discretized search; results suggest L can guarantee at least (n+1)/(2n+1) by placing marks at 1/(2n+1), 2/(2n+1), ..., n/(2n+1).
objection.witness: Missing statement: an explicit Liu division together with a proof, valid for every n and every one of Xiang Yu's at most n replies (arbitrary interleaving of new cuts), that Liu's alternating-sum total is at least c. The quoted passage reports only discretized numerical search on a guessed division and proves nothing; moreover the proposed target (n+1)/(2n+1) exceeds the true value 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) for n>=3, so no such proof exists for it.
objection.load_bearing: The claimed guarantee for Liu rests entirely on this unproved numerical observation; no strategy argument covering arbitrary Xiang replies appears anywhere in the text.
